Interface ITransportConfig

All Superinterfaces:
org.eclipse.net4j.util.security.INegotiatorAware
public interface ITransportConfig extends org.eclipse.net4j.util.security.INegotiatorAware
A common transport configuration that specifies basic dependencies for channel multiplexers, connectors and acceptors.
Since:
2.0
Author:
Eike Stepper
No Implement
This interface is not intended to be implemented by clients.
No Extend

    • getReceiveExecutor

      ExecutorService getReceiveExecutor()
      Returns the executor used for transport receive work and exposed to channel protocols. Callers must provide enough capacity for handlers and protocols that may block. In particular, blocking signal reactors can occupy workers and prevent other receive work from progressing; SignalProtocol uses this executor directly for unordered reactors and as the delegate for its default serial reactor lanes.
